hub.title: Email
hub.intro: Connect your Gmail, Microsoft 365 or any IMAP mailbox. Customer emails arrive in the team inbox, one conversation per email thread, and your replies go out from the same address.
hub.loadError: Could not load your mailboxes. Try again in a moment.
hub.connectedCount: {count, plural, one {# mailbox connected} other {# mailboxes connected}}
hub.usageUnlimited: {used, plural, one {# mailbox} other {# mailboxes}}, no limit

connect.title: Connect a mailbox
connect.body: Sign in with Google or Microsoft, or enter your mail server settings, and allow Threadwise to read and send mail for that address.

inbox.title: Mail arrives in the inbox
inbox.body: New mail is fetched every minute. Each email thread becomes one conversation, and each mailbox is its own inbox.

reply.title: Reply from the inbox
reply.body: Your reply goes out from the mailbox on the same thread, with Cc and Bcc if you add them.

limit.title: Mailboxes follow your plan
limit.body: Your plan sets how many mailboxes you can connect. Emails are not counted against your message quota.

hub.empty: No mailbox connected yet. Connect one below to start receiving email in the inbox.

google.name: Gmail / Google Workspace
google.hint: Sign in with the Google account that owns the mailbox, for example support@yourcompany.com.

imap.name: Other mail (IMAP / SMTP)
imap.hint: Any other mail provider with a username and password.

microsoft.name: Microsoft 365 / Outlook
microsoft.hint: Sign in with a Microsoft work or school account.

hub.notReady: {provider} is not set up for this platform yet. Ask your platform administrator to add the credentials.
hub.limitReached: You have used all {limit, plural, one {# mailbox} other {# mailboxes}} your plan allows. Remove a mailbox, or ask your administrator to upgrade the plan.
hub.noPermission: You can see the mailboxes, but only people allowed to manage them can connect one.
hub.connectFailed: Could not start the sign-in. Try again.
hub.imapConnected: Mailbox connected. Mail from the last 7 days is being fetched into the inbox.

scope.title: Who is this mailbox for?
scope.sharedHint: A company mailbox such as support@. The whole team can work its conversations.
scope.personalHint: Your own mailbox. Only you can read its conversations.
scope.onlyPersonal: You can connect your own personal mailbox. Only you can read its conversations.

card.needsReauthHint: The provider no longer lets us read this mailbox. Reconnect it to receive and send mail again.
card.syncStarted: Sync started. New mail appears in the inbox in a moment.
card.removeConfirm: Remove {address}? Its conversations stay in the inbox as read-only history, and no new mail is received or sent from it. You can connect the same address again later.
card.failed: Could not update the mailbox. Try again.
card.pushHint: New mail arrives as soon as the provider announces it.
card.signatureHint: Replies from this mailbox get its signature.
card.summaryNote: This is someone else's personal mailbox. Only its owner can read and manage it.
card.limitPerHour: {count, plural, one {# email per hour} other {# emails per hour}}
card.needsReauthImap: The mail server refused the saved password. Reconnect and enter the password again.

outcome.connected: Mailbox connected. Mail from the last 7 days is being fetched into the inbox.
outcome.denied: The sign-in was cancelled, so nothing was connected.
outcome.missing_scope: Access to read and send mail was not given. Connect again and allow every permission on the sign-in screen.
outcome.limit: Your plan's mailbox limit is reached, so this mailbox was not connected.
outcome.not_configured: Sign-in for this provider is not set up for this platform yet. Ask your platform administrator.
outcome.wrong_account: You signed in with a different account than the mailbox being reconnected. Sign in with the same address.
outcome.failed: Something went wrong while connecting the mailbox. Try again.

errors.notConfigured: Sign-in for this provider is not set up for this platform yet. Ask your platform administrator.
errors.limit: Your plan's mailbox limit is reached.
errors.unavailable: This mailbox is disconnected or needs to be reconnected first.
errors.sendRefused: The mail provider refused to send this email. Check the addresses and the size, then try again.
errors.wrongAccount: That is a different account than this mailbox. Sign in with the same address.
errors.locked: The email integration is not part of your plan.
errors.changed: This mailbox was changed somewhere else. The list has been reloaded, try again.
errors.personalDisabled: Personal mailboxes are turned off for this workspace.
errors.personalNotAllowed: You are not allowed to connect a personal mailbox.
errors.providerUnsupported: This mail provider is not available.
errors.rateLimited: This mailbox reached its sending limit. Try again later.

google.title: Connect Gmail or Google Workspace
google.p1: Choose Connect Gmail and sign in with the account that owns the mailbox, such as a shared support@ or sales@ address.
google.p2: On the Google screen, allow reading and sending mail. Without both, mail cannot be received or sent.
google.p3: You are brought back here and the first 7 days of mail are fetched into the inbox without notifying anyone.
google.p4: Add more mailboxes the same way, up to the number your plan allows. Each one shows as its own inbox.

consent.title: What we read and send
consent.p1: We read your inbox mail to show it in the team inbox. Spam, trash and drafts are skipped.
consent.p2: Mail we sent ourselves from your account elsewhere is not copied into the inbox.
consent.p3: Automatic replies, bounces and mailing-list mail are stored and marked Automated.
consent.p4: Removing a mailbox stops reading and sending. Its past conversations stay as read-only history.

trouble.title: If something looks wrong
trouble.p1: Needs reconnect means the provider revoked or expired the access, or the mail server refused the password. Select Reconnect.
trouble.p2: Error shows the last problem. Select Sync now to try again; if it keeps failing, reconnect the mailbox.
trouble.p3: Connect is disabled when the platform has no sign-in set up for that provider or your plan's mailbox limit is reached.
trouble.p4: Images in an email stay hidden until you choose Load images in the conversation.

other.title: Connect Microsoft 365 or another mail provider
other.p1: For Microsoft 365 or Outlook, choose Connect Microsoft 365 and sign in with the work or school account that owns the mailbox.
other.p2: For any other provider, choose Connect IMAP / SMTP and enter the server, port, security, user name and password from your provider.
other.p3: We log in to both the incoming and the outgoing server first. If one refuses, the message says which.
other.p4: Some providers need an app password instead of your normal password. Create one in your provider's security settings.

personal.title: Personal mailboxes and sharing
personal.p1: An administrator turns personal mailboxes on in Email sharing and chooses who can connect one.
personal.p2: When you connect a mailbox, choose Personal. Only you can read its conversations in the inbox.
personal.p3: Admins see only a summary of your mailbox, unless the workspace lets admins read personal mailboxes.
personal.p4: Turning personal mailboxes off never opens an existing personal mailbox to other people.

thread.imagesBlocked: Pictures from the internet are hidden.
thread.truncated: This email was long, so only the first part is shown.

bounce.title: Not delivered to {address}.
bounce.hard: The address was refused for good. Check it for typos, then send a new email to the corrected address.
bounce.soft: This looks temporary, such as a full mailbox. It may work if you send again later, or edit the address.

problem.ccInvalid: These Cc addresses are not valid: {list}
problem.bccInvalid: These Bcc addresses are not valid: {list}
problem.subjectTooLong: The subject can be at most 998 characters.

editor.linkInvalid: Enter a web, mail or phone address.
editor.label: Email reply
editor.hint: Press Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on Mac) to send. Enter starts a new line.

attach.waiting: Waiting for the files to finish uploading.
attach.fixFailed: Retry or remove the files that did not upload.

refused.empty: {name} is empty and was not added.
refused.tooLarge: {name} is larger than {max} and was not added.
refused.tooMany: Only {count} files fit in one email. {name} was not added.
refused.totalTooLarge: {name} would make the email too large and was not added.
refused.blocked: {name} is a file type that email cannot carry and was not added.

error.rateLimited: This mailbox has reached its hourly sending limit. {seconds, plural, =0 {Try again in a little while.} other {Try again in # s.}}
error.attachmentTooLarge: A file is too large to attach. Each file can be at most 10 MB and all files together at most 20 MB.
error.tooManyAttachments: Too many files. An email takes at most 10.
error.attachmentGone: An attached file expired or was removed. Attach it again.
error.signatureGone: The chosen signature no longer exists. Pick another one.
error.sendRefused: The mail provider refused this email. Check the addresses and the size, then try again.
error.unavailable: This mailbox is disconnected or needs to be reconnected first.
error.attachmentBlocked: That file type cannot be sent by email.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.generic: The email could not be sent. Try again.
error.bodyTooLong: This email is too long to send. Shorten it and try again.

imap.title: Connect IMAP / SMTP mailbox
imap.intro: Enter the settings your mail provider gives for this address. We log in to both servers before anything is saved.
imap.reconnectIntro: Enter the password again. We log in to both servers before anything is saved.
imap.presetHint: Picking one fills in the server settings. You can still change them.
imap.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
imap.passwordAgain: Type the password again. It is never shown.
imap.sameCredentials: Use the same user name and password for sending
imap.noEncryption: This connection is not encrypted. Anyone on the network could read the password and the mail.
imap.verifyNote: The server certificate is always checked.

failure.imapAuth: The incoming server (IMAP) refused the user name or password. Check them and try again.
failure.smtpAuth: The outgoing server (SMTP) refused the user name or password. Check them and try again.
failure.unreachable: Could not reach the mail server or its certificate is not valid. Check the server, port and security.
failure.generic: Could not connect the mailbox. Try again.

sharing.title: Email sharing
sharing.intro: Decide whether people can connect their own mailbox and who can see it.

enabled.title: Personal mailboxes
enabled.body: Let people connect their own mailbox. Its conversations are visible only to them.

who.title: Who can connect one
who.body: Only people with permission to manage personal mailboxes can.

admins.title: Admins can read personal mailboxes
admins.body: Admins can open the conversations of other people's personal mailboxes. When off, they see only a summary.

sharing.offNote: Turning personal mailboxes off only hides the connect option. Existing personal mailboxes stay private to their owners.

signatures.title: Signatures
signatures.intro: A signature is added at the end of your replies. Each mailbox can have a shared one, and you can keep your own, which is used first.
signatures.name: Name
signatures.variables: You can use {name}, {title} and {phone}. They are filled in with the details of the person who sends.
signatures.defaultMailbox: Use as the default for this mailbox
signatures.loadError: Could not load the signatures. Try again in a moment.
signatures.noPermission: You do not have permission to manage signatures.
signatures.changed: This signature was changed somewhere else. The list has been reloaded, try again.
signatures.failed: Could not save the signature. Try again.
